title: Separable quotients of pointwise function spaces and relative consistency
summary: Assuming Jensen's diamond principle, we construct a separable crowded compact zero-dimensional space $K$ of weight $\aleph_1$ and cardinality $2^{\aleph_1}$ such that $C_p(K)$ has no infinite-dimensional Hausdorff separable linear quotient. In particular, $K$ is an Efimov space: it contains neither a nontrivial convergent sequence nor a copy of $β\mathbb N$. We also prove in ZFC that the existence of a separable quotient of this kind is equivalent to the existence of a metrisable one.
